faqs.question: What is the official passport photo size for India?
faqs.answer: The official Indian passport photo size is 3.5 cm × 4.5 cm (35 mm × 45 mm). The face should cover 70% to 80% of the photo height (31 mm to 36 mm from crown to chin) against a plain light-colored or white background.

faqs.question: What is the official size for a US Visa or US Passport photo?
faqs.answer: The official US Visa and US Passport photo size is 2 × 2 inches (51 × 51 mm / 600 × 600 pixels at 300 DPI). The head must be between 1 inch and 1 3/8 inches (25 mm to 35 mm) from the bottom of the chin to the top of the head.

faqs.question: How many passport photos fit on an A4 sheet?
faqs.answer: On a standard A4 sheet (210 × 297 mm), you can comfortably fit between 16 to 36 passport photos (3.5×4.5 cm) depending on your margin and gap preferences. A popular standard is 32 or 36 photos (6 columns × 6 rows or 8 rows).

faqs.question: How do I print passport photos at home with high quality?
faqs.answer: Select your desired passport size and choose 'A4 Sheet' or '4×6 Photo Paper'. Download the 'Print-Ready PDF (300 DPI)', open it in your printer dialog, ensure 'Scale' is set to 100% (Actual Size - do not select 'Fit to Page'), and use glossy photo inkjet paper.

faqs.question: Are my personal passport photos uploaded to any server?
faqs.answer: No. All cropping, facial alignment overlays, grid calculations, and PDF generation occur 100% client-side inside your web browser using HTML5 Canvas. Your private photos never leave your device.

en.contentHtml:
Online Passport Photo Maker & Printable Sheet Generator (Pi7 Style)

Getting official passport photos from a commercial photo studio or pharmacy kiosk can cost between $15 and $25 per set. With our Passport Photo Maker, you can create compliant biometric passport photos right from your smartphone or laptop in seconds. Whether you need standard 3.5 × 4.5 cm photos for Indian passports, Schengen visas, and pan cards, or 2 × 2 inch photos for US passports and green cards, this free online tool generates razor-sharp 300 DPI individual cutouts and multiple-photo printable sheets.

Official Country Passport & Visa Photo Size Standards

Country / Document Metric Size (mm) Imperial Size (in) 300 DPI Resolution (px) Head Ratio Guide
India Passport / PAN / OCI 35 × 45 mm 1.38 × 1.77 in 413 × 531 px 70% - 80% (31mm - 36mm)
United States (Passport & Visa) 51 × 51 mm 2.0 × 2.0 in 600 × 600 px 50% - 69% (25mm - 35mm)
United Kingdom & Schengen (Europe) 35 × 45 mm 1.38 × 1.77 in 413 × 531 px 70% - 80% (29mm - 34mm)
Canada Passport 50 × 70 mm 1.97 × 2.76 in 591 × 827 px 31mm - 36mm face height
Australia Passport 35 × 45 mm 1.38 × 1.77 in 413 × 531 px 32mm - 36mm crown to chin
Stamp Size Photo 25 × 30 mm 0.98 × 1.18 in 295 × 354 px Compact ID card documents

How to Print Passport Photos on A4 & 4×6 Photo Paper at Home

1

Choose Photo Paper

Use heavyweight glossy or semi-gloss photo inkjet paper (180 to 240 GSM). Avoid plain copy paper which absorbs ink and turns dull.

2

Set Scale to 100% (Actual Size)

In your printer dialog, ensure "Fit to Printable Area" or "Shrink to Fit" is turned OFF. Select "100% Actual Size" to maintain exact millimeter measurements.

3

Cut with Crop Guides

Enable 'Crop Marks' before downloading your sheet. Align a metal ruler along the tick marks and cut cleanly with a hobby knife or paper trimmer.

faqs.question: भारतीय पासपोर्ट के लिए फोटो का आधिकारिक साइज क्या है?

faqs.question: यूएस वीजा (US Visa) के लिए फोटो का साइज क्या है?
faqs.answer: अमेरिकी वीजा और पासपोर्ट के लिए आधिकारिक साइज 2 × 2 इंच (51 × 51 मिमी / 600 × 600 पिक्सल 300 DPI पर) है।

faqs.question: एक A4 शीट पर कितने पासपोर्ट फोटो प्रिंट हो सकते हैं?
faqs.answer: एक A4 शीट (210 × 297 मिमी) पर 16 से लेकर 36 पासपोर्ट साइज फोटो आसानी से प्रिंट किए जा सकते हैं।

faqs.question: क्या मेरी तस्वीरें सर्वर पर सुरक्षित रहती हैं?
faqs.answer: हाँ, आपकी तस्वीरें कभी भी किसी सर्वर पर अपलोड नहीं होतीं। पूरा प्रोसेस आपके ब्राउज़र में 100% प्राइवेट और ऑफलाइन होता है।

faqs.question: 대한민국 표준 여권 사진의 규격은 어떻게 되나요?
faqs.answer: 가로 3.5cm, 세로 4.5cm이며 머리 길이(정수리부터 턱까지)가 3.2cm ~ 3.6cm 사이여야 하며 배경은 흰색이어야 합니다.
